current.text: He left Utah and is locked in as the Lakers' starting center.
He played five games last season before shoulder surgery.
The Lakers' backup centers are weak: Kevon Looney and Mamukelashvili. The team's defense depends heavily on him.
With weak backups behind him, he should play heavy minutes.
Andy expects Luka Doncic to make him look very good as a roller and dunking threat.
Expected line: double-digit rebounds, 12 to 15 points with about six coming off offensive rebounds, 2+ blocks and bad free throws.
Last season's five-game sample was inflated by unsustainable three-point shooting and a high steal rate. Experts expect his threes and steals to come down, which also lowers his FG% and scoring.
Josh says the five games last season should not scare drafters off. He might play 80 games.
His Yahoo price is too high. Experts call a top 30 pick far too early and his Yahoo rank of about 37 with an ADP around 32 to 35 too high. Pick 42 is better, but still not loved.
At his ESPN ADP of 80 he is a fine or easy pick.
His draft spot varies a lot, from early round 3 to late round 4.
A very good pick if your team is low on rebounds.

durable.text: A three-category center: rebounds, FG% and blocks are his strengths, and all three are league outliers.
Free throws are a clear weakness. FT% is a league outlier on the weak side.
Nothing else in his profile is strong. Experts rate his assists, steals and threes near the bottom of the league.
An elite rim protector and defensive rebounder.
He has a 20 to 25% career three-point percentage. Lloyd does not trust his new three-point attempts.
He has had arm or shoulder problems in two of the last three seasons, including shoulder surgery.
It is unclear how many minutes his body can handle.

note: Kessler is a three-category center (BLK, REB, FG%) with a bad FT% and few threes, assists or steals, so he fits best in a punt FT build. Prices are far apart: Yahoo values him at 24 USD (average cost 18.8), ESPN at 13 USD (8.5), and he went for 15 USD in our league last season. The experts think his Yahoo price is too high and that he is fine around his ESPN level, so pay close to 15 USD and do not chase him into the 20s. Early in the season, check whether his threes and steals drop back to his usual low levels, how his FT% looks on more attempts, and whether his shoulder holds up under starter minutes.
